$comment: Vendor rates in USD, each read from the vendor's own pricing page on the date in `asOf` -- see rates-sources.md for the page and the plan tier each one came from. A value stays null until it can be read from the vendor directly; estimateSessionCost() throws naming any null it needs, so the cost model can never invent a price (guardrail 8, spec §4). Update `asOf` whenever a rate changes.
